test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete a piece of work in 20 days. B can complete the same work in 36 days. If A and B work together, then the number of days required to complete the work is:
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 20 days.

B can complete the work in 36 days.

**Concept Used:**

Work rate of A = 1/20 of the work per day.

Work rate of B = 1/36 of the work per day.

Combined work rate of A and B = (1/20) + (1/36).

**Calculation:**

⇒ Combined work rate = (9 + 5)/180 = 14/180 = 7/90 of the work per day.

⇒ Number of days required = 1 / (7/90) = 90/7.

⇒ Number of days = 90/7 = 12 (6)/(7) 

⇒ Number of days = 12 (6)/(7) 

**∴ A and B together will complete the work in 12 (6)/(7) **
